0022600187.text: The Orlando Magic (2-5) head into their 8th game of the season on a two-game losing streak, sitting 12th in the East and 2 games back in the Southeast, with a 2-1 road record but an 0-4 mark at home. The Phoenix Suns (1-5) are 12th in the West and 4.5 games back in the Pacific after losing four straight, and Orlando is missing Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain) and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), while Phoenix is without Jordan Goodwin (calf), Mark Williams (shoulder, surgery) and Rasheer Fleming (ankle sprain). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, after splitting their 2025-26 series 1-1, with the Magic winning the most recent meeting 115-111 in Orlando on March 31, 2026.
